messages:
Anya: Quick heads-up — prepping internal release notes for v2.4.0 and scheduling a staging dry-run tonight 23:00 UTC. Need ops + oncall signoff and agreement on rollback cadence. Draft RN below, pls comment inline.

Anya: ```
Release v2.4.0 (staging dry-run)
- Features: smarter batching heuristics, KV cache eviction fix, model runtime pin for stability
- Ops notes: pin runtime to model-x-20260315, enable prefix caching for typical seq lengths (<=1024)
- Known issues: transient increased p95 during cold-starts for long contexts
```

June: I'm available for 23:00 UTC. Proposal: 30m dry-run with simulated traffic, forced rollback point at +15m if we hit the thresholds.

Chris: +1 to the model pin. Suggest explicit pin: tag=model-x-20260315. If autoscaler replaces instances, fallback should be to quantized variant (model-x-quant-20260315) to avoid OOMs. cc @SRE-Oncall

DeployBot: deploybot: scheduled dry-run job created: job-id dr-1777778888. Command: `/deploy --dry-run --env=staging --job=dr-1777778888 --traffic=simulated@500rps`

SRE-Oncall: No blackout tonight. Oncall will be available. Rollback command to keep handy: `./ops/rollback.sh --target release/v2.4.0`
Thresholds to trigger rollback (agreed):
- error_rate >= 0.5% sustained for 3m
- OR p95 latency >= 1200ms sustained for 5m

Mike: Thanks — link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-staging-dryrun
I'll coordinate the canary cadence: 10m canary at 10% -> 10m at 50% -> full ramp if green. If we hit a threshold, immediate rollback and postmortem. I'll chair.

Anya: Updated the RN and pinned the model line. Final ops snippet added to the notes: ```
Ops checklist (staging dry-run)
1) Confirm deploybot job created (dr-1777778888)
2) Run simulated traffic @500rps for 30m
3) Monitor alerts (error_rate, p95) and tracing for regressions
4) At +15m, evaluate: if thresholds crossed -> trigger rollback via `./ops/rollback.sh --target release/v2.4.0`
5) If stable, follow Mike cadence for canary ramp in staging
```

June: :thumbsup: Added to calendar and set reminder. I put a 30m post-dry-run sync on the calendar (23:45 UTC) so we can capture notes and next steps.

Anya: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post the internal blast copy after the dry-run results. If anything changes, ping here or DM.
